approved: 2026-10-20, Claude (lead), codes transcribed from the official dictionary; microdata not yet downloaded

notes.household_key_columns: read only to count residents per consumption unit (household_size); dropped before export by the loader
notes.household_income_brl: RENDA_TOTAL = gross total monthly income of the consumption unit (UC), R$; per capita = RENDA_TOTAL / household_size
notes.income_tables: Rendimento do Trabalho and Outros Rendimentos tables carry V9001 (income type, see Cadastro de Produtos.xls) and V8500_DEFLA (deflated amount); their benefit-code mapping is a C3 task
notes.year: the loader requires a year column; add it as a constant when exporting with the official reading program
